channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Americans Struggle with Debt Payments Amid Inflation
item.description: Rising inflation is causing more Americans to fall behind on their debt payments, particularly credit card repayments. This situation has led to an increased demand for debt advice services. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Consumer Spending Remains Strong Amidst Economic Uncertainty
item.description: Despite economic uncertainties, American consumers continue to spend, a trend that has sustained the economy. Reports suggest that the wealth held by older Americans may be a significant factor contributing to this ongoing consumer… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: BlackRock and Goldman Sachs Adjust Investment Strategies
item.description: BlackRock has shifted its investment strategy, becoming bullish on short-term bonds and downgrading its outlook on stocks. In contrast, Goldman Sachs has adopted a long position on both stocks and bonds. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Broadcom CEO's 'Casino' Remark Sparks Chip Stock Sell-off
item.description: Chip stocks experienced a decline following remarks made by the CEO of Broadcom, Hock Tan, who described many investors in the artificial intelligence (AI) sector as akin to "casino gamblers." The comments led to a sell-off in the sector. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: English councils warn of £10bn overspend on special needs support
item.description: English councils are facing potentially "catastrophic" debts, projected to reach £10bn by 2028, due to a surge in demand for special educational needs (SEN) support. This increase in Education, Health and Care Plan (EHCP) applications… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Fuel Prices Surge in Australia Amid Global Oil Concerns
item.description: Petrol prices across Australia have surpassed $2.40 a litre, with little immediate relief anticipated. An International Monetary Fund (IMF) scenario suggests that a worsening Middle East crisis could lead to a global oil price increase of… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New Cantonese Restaurant in Manly Receives Two Hats
item.description: A new Cantonese restaurant located in Manly has been awarded two hats. The establishment features a world-class chef. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Omron to Acquire US Firm Onlogic for $675 Million
item.description: Japanese technology company Omron has announced its intention to acquire the US-based industrial PC firm Onlogic for $675 million. This acquisition is part of Omron's strategy to advance its capabilities in physical artificial intelligence… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Japanese Finance Minister to Chair World Bank-IMF Development Panel
item.description: Japan's Finance Minister, Shunichi Suzuki, has been named the next chair of the joint development committee of the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank. He will be the first Japanese national to hold this position. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Dangote Refinery Extends IPO Offer for Broader African Investor Access
item.description: Nigeria's Dangote refinery has extended its Initial Public Offering (IPO) of $1.6 billion. The extension aims to provide more African countries with an opportunity to invest in the record-breaking offer, broadening investor access across… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Huanggang Port Reopens After Six-Year Redevelopment
item.description: The Huanggang Port, a border crossing between Shenzhen and Hong Kong, has reopened following a six-year redevelopment project. The port is now operational and has begun serving businesses. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: LVMH Sales Rise Slightly Amid Fashion Sector Decline
item.description: LVMH reported a slight increase in overall sales, despite a downturn in its fashion and leather goods division during the third quarter. This performance has cast a shadow over the fragile recovery of the luxury sector, dashing hopes for a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Starbucks Denies Reports of Chipotle Takeover Plans
item.description: Starbucks has denied reports suggesting it was planning to acquire Chipotle. The denial comes after speculation circulated about a potential takeover. One report indicated that Starbucks communicated to financial commentator Jim Cramer… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Global Markets Mixed Amid Earnings Data and Oil Prices
item.description: Global stock markets showed mixed performance as investors awaited US earnings data, while oil prices remained elevated. European stocks, specifically the STOXX 600, closed higher, with bank shares helping to offset the impact of oil price… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US Suspends Green Card Filings for Indian IT Firms
item.description: The United States has suspended green card filings for Indian IT companies Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Wipro, and HCL. This action is expected to have a negative impact on Indian IT workers seeking permanent residency in the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia claims Europe bought $320 billion in hydrocarbons since 2022
item.description: Russia claims Europe has purchased hydrocarbons worth $320 billion since the beginning of 2022. Russian Energy Minister Novak stated that oil exports from Russia may return to pre-war levels by the end of the current year. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Leapmotor-Stellantis JV comments on EU-China import cap deal
item.description: The joint venture between Leapmotor and Stellantis has described the European Union's deal to cap Chinese electric vehicle imports as an "interesting alternative." The statement was made in response to the EU's decision to impose… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Moonshot AI Executives in Dispute Settlement Talks Ahead of IPO
item.description: Executives at Moonshot AI are reportedly in discussions to settle a dispute with a shareholder. This development comes as the company is planning a significant initial public offering (IPO). Moonshot AI is aiming for a record $50 billion… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Visa Gains Approval for China Domestic Payments Business
item.description: Visa has received approval to begin preparations for its domestic payments business in China. The approval allows for the establishment of a locally registered bank card organization. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: IMF Warns of Financial Risks from AI Bubble and High Government Debt
item.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has warned that the threat of an AI share price crash could put global financial stability at risk due to high valuations and debt within the sector. The IMF is also urging governments to rebuild… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: India and Bangladesh Discuss Trade Barriers
item.description: India and Bangladesh held talks to address trade barriers, marking the first such discussion after a prolonged gap. Bangladesh has requested India to remove trade restrictions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Agilisium and CIEL HR Set Revenue and Hiring Targets
item.description: Life sciences technology company Agilisium plans to train over 700 forward-deployment experts, establish Hyderabad as its eastern hemisphere hub, and aims for $500 million in revenue within five to seven years, while also targeting to… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Finance Minister Urges Steel Makers to Boost Specialty Steel Output
item.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has urged domestic steel producers to prioritize decarbonization and increase the production of specialty steel. The minister's call aims to reduce India's reliance on imported specialty steel. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Old Monk Maker Faces FSSAI Label Dispute, Factory Shutdown
item.description: Mohan Rocky Springwater Pvt Ltd, the maker of Old Monk, has stated that its factory in Khopoli has been shut since May due to a standoff with the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) over a 'rum-like' label. The company… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Poultry Feed Prices Rise, Affecting Meat Retailers
item.description: Meat retailers are experiencing a negative impact due to an increase in poultry feed prices. This rise is attributed to a weak monsoon and the demand for ethanol. The effects are expected to be felt by food businesses before consumers. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: L&T Technology Services launches AI-native factory lab with NVIDIA
item.description: L&T Technology Services (LTTS) has launched an EI Lab focused on manufacturing and operations, which features an NVIDIA accelerated AI-native factory. The lab aims to advance industrial automation and digital transformation. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Google Launches New Fitbit Edge Fitness Tracker
item.description: Google has launched the Fitbit Edge, a new fitness tracker featuring a color display and a replaceable battery. The device is priced at $180 and includes features such as ECG capability and a battery life of up to seven days. Forbes noted… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: SEBI Introduces Common Ad Code, Permits Celebrity Endorsements
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has notified a common advertising code for market intermediaries. This new code also permits celebrity endorsements for brands. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: HD Fire IPO Sees High Pre-Listing Demand Amidst Niche Market Concerns
item.description: The Initial Public Offering (IPO) for HD Fire is experiencing significant demand, with its Grey Market Premium (GMP) indicating a strong listing and potential for substantial profits. Investors are evaluating the company's competitive… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Bullet Train Project Progresses in Vadodara
item.description: Work on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad Bullet Train project has advanced in Vadodara, with the completion of all 14 portal beams over the main railway line. The Financial Express notes that work is picking up pace and raises questions about what… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: AI Growth Faces Capital Bottleneck, Say Intel and Broadcom CEOs
item.description: The chief executive officers of Intel and Broadcom have stated that a capital crunch, rather than memory chips, poses the most significant obstacle to the growth of artificial intelligence (AI). They warned that insufficient capital could… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Debt Funds Sell Bonds After RBI Policy Shift
item.description: Indian debt funds sold a net ₹51 billion ($527.08 million) of government bonds in the three trading sessions following the Reserve Bank of India's (RBI) policy shift and rate increase. This follows a larger selloff of ₹378 billion in… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: India Wastes 4% Solar Power During July-August Shortages
item.description: India wasted approximately 4% of its solar power during July and August, a period marked by power shortages. This wastage occurred despite the country facing deficits in electricity supply during those months. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: TCS to hire 80% of new employees with AI skills
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) plans to hire 80% of its new employees with digital and AI skills, with 25-30% of its 4,500 hires in the second quarter specializing purely in AI. AI-led work currently accounts for 10% of TCS's revenue, and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Rise on October 9
item.description: On October 9, the prices of gold and silver saw an increase. The latest rates for gold were reported in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 1.

item.title: Tom Cruise Film 'Digger' Faces Potential $245 Million Box Office Loss
item.description: The film 'Digger,' an eco-satire starring Tom Cruise and directed by Alejandro G. Iñárritu, is projected to incur a loss of $245 million at the box office. This potential loss places it among significant financial disappointments in cinema… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: US Bull Market Nears Milestone Amid AI-Driven Profits
item.description: The US bull market is approaching a four-year milestone, propelled by investments in AI infrastructure that have fueled a 117% rally in the S&P 500. Despite this growth, market concentration in major tech companies, 10-year Treasury yields… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: BYD Considers Factory in France, Executive Says
item.description: Chinese electric vehicle manufacturer BYD is considering plans to establish a factory in France, according to an executive. France is among the European countries on the company's shortlist for potential plant locations, with… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Amol Walvekar Discusses Enterprise AI Advancement
item.description: Amol Walvekar is advancing enterprise artificial intelligence, focusing on the transition from AI experimentation to realizing tangible business value. His work emphasizes the importance for CEOs to understand the unit economics of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Firmus IPO Collapse Impacts Asia's AI Deal Market
item.description: The initial public offering (IPO) of Firmus Grid Ltd. has collapsed, impacting Asia's market for share sales. This event is making investors more selective regarding artificial intelligence infrastructure deals that depend on future… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
